uds_mri

Source: R/data.R
uds_mri.Rd

NACCADRC UDS Imaging MRI dataset. Mixed protocol (non-SCAN compliant) MRI. The data is sourced from the file(s) investigator_mri_nacc73.csv.

Usage

data(uds_mri)

Format

A data frame with 12180 rows and 191 variables:

NACCADC

ADC at which participant was seen (100 –9999)

NACCID

Participant ID
